reason: Because I already gave $200 to the ambulance fund this month and remember the first campaign failing, I need to feel confident this effort will actually succeed before I chip in again. Document B convinces me to make a smaller pledge by naming the Majestic, committing to quarterly spending reports at the library, and including the $11,000 in local business pledges—which brings the remaining community goal down to $49,000, making it feel completely achievable compared to the $47,000 we raised last time.
